annotation.title_clean: Policy on the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Administration of Justice
annotation.title_en: Policy on the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Administration of Justice
annotation.authors_or_issuer: CTEAJE / Spanish Administration of Justice (CGPJ, FGE, Ministry of the Presidency, Justice and Parliamentary Relations)
annotation.summary_en: Spanish 2024 policy setting minimum criteria for responsible, legal and ethical use of AI, including generative AI, in the Administration of Justice. It adopts CEPEJ principles, allocates responsibilities, requires human review and GenAI labelling, and annexes definitions plus permitted and prohibited use cases.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI must not replace judges' decision-making; human review of outputs affecting rights is required
Adopts CEPEJ five principles plus equity, bias prevention, privacy, continuous evaluation, training and co-governance
GenAI outputs must be identified as AI-generated; unauthorised AI tools and APIs prohibited
CGPJ audits AI affecting judicial independence; CTEAJE or benefit administration otherwise
Annex II lists permitted and prohibited uses, e.g. automatic issuance of definitive resolutions without human supervision
